name: Situation – Behaviour – Impact

steps.title: Situation
steps.description: When and where, specifically (for example: the last 90 days, Monday and Tuesday starts).

steps.title: Behaviour
steps.description: The observable action, not a judgement of the person (for example: 14 arrivals after 09:30).

steps.title: Impact
steps.description: The concrete effect on the team, the client or the work.

then: Ask an open question and listen to the answer
Agree how and when it will be checked
